training_station_eligibility: at least one structurally valid R1 training sample; not instrument certification
availability_note: At least one numeric hour after current QC, not complete-year coverage or approved training eligibility
hourly_targets: six separate next hourly depths at the same station
daily_targets: three separate next 24-hour totals at the same station
proposed_training_design: one pooled model per architecture across eligible stations
station_predictor_spatial_method: strict bilinear from four native ERA5 0.25 degree nodes at station coordinates
source_time_confirmation: user explicit confirmation 2026-11-09: 10:00 is rain 09:00-10:00 Vietnam UTC+7
daily_interval_local: 19:00 previous day to 19:00 marked day, all 24 hours required
current_short_range_method: archived GFS forecast + gauge history; LightGBM A0-A3 and small GRU_A2
